params.body:
FlexLease answered 'The selected fuel is invalid.' for most of our fuel types. Their API (https://peugeotdebacker.flexlease.rent/api/v1/, checked today, no key, no IP restriction) accepts exactly five names, case-sensitive: Benzine, Diesel, Elektrisch, Hybride Benzine, Hybride Diesel. Our list has fifteen ('PHEV Hybride - Benzine', 'MHEV Hybride - Diesel', CNG, LPG, Waterstof, ...).

- FlexLeaseService::fuelFor() maps ours to theirs (any hybrid with benzine/diesel -> Hybride Benzine/Diesel; electric -> Elektrisch); a fuel without an equivalent (CNG, LPG, hydrogen, ethanol) goes out as null so their answer stays 'invalid' and the page says the price is unavailable, rather than pricing a fuel the car does not have. Used in the price call and both PDF calls.
- Unit test over the whole list.
- CUTOVER.md: FLEXLEASE_URL with the value, and flexlease in OUTBOUND_ALLOW on staging.
params.title: FlexLease: fuel names their API accepts
